statements.t: “We have made important progress advancing Surrozen into its next stage of development, with the first patient dosed in the SZN-8141 DUET study and plans to significantly expand Phase 2a enrollment from approximately 60 to 150 patients,” said Craig Parker, President and Chief Executive Officer of Surrozen.
“The additional capital raised in October positions us to generate a more robust clinical dataset across a broader DME population, while maintaining anticipated cash runway into 2029.”

The Company anticipates its cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities to provide cash runway into 2029, including funding for completion of the expanded DUET Phase 1b/2a study of SZN-8141 and initial Phase 1b clinical development of SZN-8143.

dropped.t: (Surrozen or the Company) (Nasdaq: SRZN), a biotechnology company pioneering targeted therapeutics to harness the power of Wnt signaling to address the underlying drivers of disease in sight-threatening ophthalmic conditions, today announced the closing of the second and final tranche of its March 2025 private placement of securities.

"With expected cash runway into 2029, we are well positioned to advance SZN-8141 into the DUET Phase 1b/2a study and initiate clinical development of SZN-8143, while maintaining a disciplined approach to capital allocation."
